description_en: Lists the log analysis configurations in log analysis
description_zh: 列出日志分析中配置的日志转储信息
kebab_example: aliyun nas describe-log-analysis --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-size 1 --page-number 1 --file-system-type all --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLogAnalysis

parameters.help_en: The number of file systems on each page in a paging query. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时，每个分页包含的文件系统个数。
取值范围：1~100
默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the file system list. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 文件系统列表的分页页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The file system type.

Valid values:

standard: General-purpose NAS
extreme: Extreme NAS
all (default): all types
parameters.help_zh:
文件系统类型。

取值：

standard：通用型NAS
extreme：极速型NAS
all（默认值）：所有类型
parameters.name: file_system_type

Analysis.description_en: The collection of log analysis entries

MetaValue.description_en: The log analysis information of the specified file system
MetaValue.description_zh: 指定文件系统对应的日志转储信息

Logstore.description_en: The name of the dedicated Logstore that stores NAS operation logs
Logstore.description_zh: 用于存储NAS操作日志的专属Logstore名称

Project.description_en: The name of the project where the dedicated Logstore for file system operation logs resides
Project.description_zh: 文件系统操作日志专属Logstore所在的Project名称

Region.description_en: The region where the dedicated Logstore for file system operation logs resides
Region.description_zh: 文件系统操作日志专属Logstore所在地域

RoleArn.description_en: The role that File Storage NAS uses to access Simple Log Service
RoleArn.description_zh: NAS访问日志服务所使用的角色

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the log analysis entries
PageNumber.description_zh: 日志转储信息的分页页码

PageSize.description_en: The number of log analysis entries on each page
PageSize.description_zh: 每个分页包含的日志转储信息数量

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of log analysis entries in the region
TotalCount.description_zh: 该地域日志转储信息总量
